scope: Authored task-family gap inventory for spoken/written Lithuanian and Mexican Spanish; not an exhaustive official descriptor inventory

themes: Find a stop and buy a ticket
Plan a meal for a group
Explain a problem and a next step
Balance access in a public space

families.nextWork: Vary layout, purpose and contextual detail beyond the prepared message bank.
Broaden genres and interpretations; keep first exposure separate from repeats.
Prepared four-part narrative and analytical readings exist in selected B1–C2 units. Broaden text length, genres, independent transfer and leisure reading.
Prepared practical tables are present in selected A1–A2 units. Add varied documents and higher-band visual sources with explicit preparation.
Current sources have controlled recordings. Review pace, variety and discourse demands by band.
Extend beyond short controlled messages with varied speakers and purposes.
Add complete exchanges between distinct speakers and questions about the relationship between turns.
Add sustained talks with taught preparation, a note-taking purpose and questions about structure and emphasis.
Add rights-cleared audio/video and teach relevant nonverbal and genre cues.
Broaden subjects and require varied responses across several occasions.
Current higher-band prompts support selected positions. Add audience-specific presentations and follow-up challenges.
Add complete announcement and presentation tasks with audience, register and delivery preparation.
Recorded fixed turns and selected branches are practice, not unpredictable conversation.
Current branch selection drives the partner response. Add further clarification chains and transfer contexts.
Add a live interlocutor workflow and record observations against task-specific criteria.
Teach shared decision making, floor management and responding to genuinely different contributions.
Foundation and workshop tasks contain selected service situations. Audit systematic breadth and add interviews and telephone-specific tasks.
There are 84 guided projects. Review genre breadth and repeated independent performance by band.
There are prepared message exchanges. Add varied audiences, purposes and less predictable replies.
Original and changed-source forms exist in meeting, travel and service units. Expand practical documents only where appropriate.
Add threaded discussion, contributions from multiple people and a shared outcome; prepared one-to-one messages cover only part of this demand.
Current tasks preserve source details in recorded self-reviewed responses. Broaden audience and source demands.
Add charts/tables with taught labels and require a useful interpretation for a specified audience.
Written-source notes are reused in revised audience briefs. Broaden source genres and independent performance.
Written-source preparation is implemented separately. Add purposeful notes during lectures, meetings and seminars; reading notes do not demonstrate this oral-input scale.
Teach meaning-preserving translation choices and evaluate the actual translated artifact.
A short higher-band literature workshop exists. Broaden texts, genres and supported alternative interpretations.

families.family: Construct shared meaning and resolve disagreement
families.nextWork: Add collaborative concept building and delicate communication with actual contributions from other people.
Planning, self-review and revision are implemented. Review transfer without frames and adequacy of independent repairs.
Higher-band changed-source questions target selected interpretations. Audit the variety of cues and assess inference on different occasions.

families.family: Vocabulary, grammar, spelling and sound control
families.nextWork: Prepared vocabulary, controlled grammar, audio models and replay exist. These do not establish independent control, intelligibility or broad range.
Some higher-band tasks teach these choices. Independent performance and broader discourse evidence are still needed.
